COLDWAR_SYR_initial_profile = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_politics_initialized }
		}
		IMP_1970_clear_politics = yes
		set_popularities = { democratic = 9 communism = 70 fascism = 0 neutrality = 12 nationalist = 9 }
		set_politics = { ruling_party = communism elections_allowed = no }
		set_country_flag = IMP_1970_historical_politics
		set_variable = { ruling_party = 7 }
		set_variable = { disable_elections = 1 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^1 = 0.04 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^2 = 0.02 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^3 = 0.03 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^4 = 0.08 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^7 = 0.62 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^12 = 0.04 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^13 = 0.08 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^20 = 0.02 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^21 = 0.02 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^22 = 0.05 }
		startup_politics = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_SYR_accept_national_pact = {
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_national_pact
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_pact_rejected
	set_variable = { disable_elections = 0 }
	# Native MD election helpers retain ROOT's outlook and suppress a leader change.
	# An omitted ruling_party leaves the native politics tooltip without an ideology.
	set_country_flag = no_leader_change
	set_politics = { ruling_party = ROOT elections_allowed = yes election_frequency = 48 }
	clr_country_flag = no_leader_change
	set_variable = { party_banned_array^1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { party_banned_array^2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { party_banned_array^4 = 0 }
	set_variable = { party_banned_array^7 = 0 }
	set_variable = { party_banned_array^12 = 0 }
	set_variable = { party_banned_array^13 = 0 }
	set_variable = { party_banned_array^20 = 0 }
	set_variable = { party_banned_array^21 = 0 }
	set_variable = { party_banned_array^22 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_political_bureau_formed }
		set_variable = { party_banned_array^3 = 0 }
	}
	update_dirty_politicsview_expanded = yes
	update_set_politics = yes
	COLDWAR_SYR_refresh_programmes = yes
}
COLDWAR_SYR_install_khatib = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 7 }
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_corrective_transition
		}
		if = {
			limit = { date < 1983.1.1 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_baath_head = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_baath_head = 4 }
		}
		COLDWAR_SYR_1970_set_leader = yes
	}
}

# A policy mandate is separate from the presidency. This helper never retires
# or creates a character, so recognizing Jadid cannot kill/recreate al-Atassi.
COLDWAR_SYR_sync_baath_mandate = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_leader_atassi
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_leader_jadid
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 7 }
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_baath_head = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_baath_mandate = 1 }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_leader_jadid
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_leader_atassi }
	}
	COLDWAR_SYR_refresh_programmes = yes
}

COLDWAR_SYR_check_cabinet_contracts = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_rights_cabinet = ruling_party }
			}
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_darwish_coalition_active
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_badr_coalition_active
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_discriminatory_settlement }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_darwish_coalition_active
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_badr_coalition_active
	}
}
COLDWAR_SYR_politics_weekly = {
	COLDWAR_SYR_check_cabinet_contracts = yes
	# Only the death year is established for al-Khatib. From the first day after
	# 1982, a prolonged alternate stewardship continues as a collective council.
	if = {
		limit = { date > 1982.12.31 has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_leader_khatib }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_SYR_baath_head = 4 }
		COLDWAR_SYR_1970_set_leader = yes
	}
	# Incapacity is a later conditional crisis with a real provider. It opens a
	# conference; it never chooses the successor or changes office on a timer.
	if = {
		limit = {
			date > 1983.11.1
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_leader_hafez
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_presidential_state_established
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_rival_guard_commands
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_incapacity_warning_seen }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_incapacity_warning_seen
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SYR_POL.11 days = 1 }
	}
	# Crop emergencies are bounded by duration and a two-year recovery period.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SYR_agriculture_entry
			NOT = {
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_crop_crisis has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_weather_recovery }
			}
		}
		random = {
			chance = 1
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_SYR_crop_crisis days = 180 }
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_SYR_weather_recovery days = 730 }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_SYR_politics_crop_crisis days = 180 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_discriminatory_settlement
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_unrest_warning_seen }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_unrest_warning_seen
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SYR_POL.12 days = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			date > 1980.1.1
			has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_SYR_baath_09
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_unrest_warning_seen
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_civilian_guarantees
				}
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_unrest_warning_seen
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SYR_POL.12 days = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SYR_crop_crisis }
			has_idea = COLDWAR_SYR_politics_drought_relief
		}
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SYR_politics_drought_relief
	}
}
